title: MazeQuest 2
description: The King has been kidnapped, and the land of Reynard is under siege! Gather a party, and travel your way to different lands on a quest to re-seal an ancient evil. MazeQuest 2 is a mashup tribute to the great console RPGs of the 90's, with infinite replay, fun storylines and sidequests, fantastic beasts, dragons, trolls, and more!. This game has everything you ever wanted in an RPG, including party based combat, 50 learnable skills, 17 recruitable characters, and hundreds of randomly generated items!
